The trace places the vehicle at 27.18 km travelled, not the 27.2 km rounded convenience copy on the trip_record, and POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure the governing measurement.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. The artifacts describe the same trip: trip_id TRP-00101 and the 10:21:05 pickup timestamp match across the trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown, and a threshold-meeting excess is measured from an unimpaired trace. The burden shifts to the driver to point to a specific artifact and clause, and he points to none.

The driver's own in-app message — 'sorry boss missed the exit, coming back now' — is a driver admission recorded in the chat_log, one of the independent corroborating sources POL-RD-07(ii) names, and it squarely corroborates the deviation. His counterparty_statement repeats the admission ('I took a wrong turn at the MCE exit'), and no exculpatory account appears anywhere in the record.

No exculpatory clause rescues the driver. The only traffic_advisory in the bundle is MISSING, carrying issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT with weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run on the record and the absence cannot carry the driver's excuse under POL-RD-13; the chat_log shows no rider instruction to detour as POL-RD-04(a) requires, and no rider message names any waypoint; no pickup or dropoff amendment exists for POL-RD-05 (both amendment timestamps are null); the fare is METERED, so POL-RD-11 is out; and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The deviation stands at the measured figure.

Under POL-RD-02 the refund is arithmetic: recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 21.0 km + 0.28 x 26.0 min) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee = 27.63, with no ERP, toll, surcharge, waiting fee or promo line to adjust. The refund is charged_total 35.64 minus 27.63 = 8.01, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05, giving SGD 8.05.

The refund of 8.05 is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, so it is not a NO_ACTION; and at 22.5% of charged_total it is well below the 90% full-refund share, so it is not a FULL_REFUND. The correct outcome for this rider-filed dispute is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 8.05, returning to the rider the distance and time charged for a detour he never asked for.

There is no pass-through line to correct or double-count: erp_lines is empty and the off-optimal-route and on-optimal-route ERP totals are both 0.00, and no airport surcharge arises on a trip that neither originates nor terminates at an airport. The POL-RD-02 figure therefore neither reduces nor supplements on POL-RD-09 grounds, and the rider's remedy is the 8.05 refund alone.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this is a rider-filed route-deviation dispute over trip TRP-00101 (Jurong East MRT to Marina Bay Sands, 12 July 2026).

Deviation. The controlling distance is the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00101), which POL-RD-01 makes govern over the rounded trip-record copy (27.2 km). The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 — 229 fixes at the 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0.0 s — so none of limbs (a) to (c) fires, and the rider's threshold excess is measured from it directly. The trace records 27.18 km against the booked optimal route of 21.0 km (EV-TRIP-00101), an excess of 6.18 km, or 29.43%. That clears both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20%), so a route deviation is ESTABLISHED, and the rider's POL-RD-08 burden is discharged (trip id TRP-00101 and the 10:21:05 pickup timestamp match across trace, trip record and fare breakdown). The excess does not reach either materiality threshold (8.0 km or 50%), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged and no driver-conduct referral arises; independently, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 over 812 completed trips in 90 days, so no repeat pattern is established, and the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is context only and cannot be substituted.

Exculpation. Nothing excuses the deviation. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00101) contains no rider instruction to detour and no waypoint, so POL-RD-04 fails; both pickup and dropoff amendment timestamps are null, so POL-RD-05 fails; the fare is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not apply; and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The bundle's only traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00101-01) is MISSING with weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03 cannot run on the record; no party asserted an external queue, breakdown, closure or incident, and POL-RD-13 confirms the absent advisory does not convert into a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. The driver's own in-app message ('sorry boss missed the exit, coming back now') and his counterparty statement are admissions that corroborate the deviation rather than excuse it.

Refund. On a METERED fare, POL-RD-02 gives the arithmetic: charged_total = 35.64; recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 21.0 km + 0.28 x 26.0 min) x 1.0 surge (read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 27.63; refund = 35.64 - 27.63 = 8.01, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 8.05. That figure is the whole of the rider's monetary remedy: it is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis, so not NO_ACTION, and at 22.5% of charged_total it is far below the 90% full-refund share, so not FULL_REFUND. It is less than the SGD 10.00 contested. There is no ERP, toll or surcharge line to correct under POL-RD-09 (all totals are 0.00 and no gantry was charged), and any off-route ERP would in any event be comprehended in the POL-RD-02 figure rather than added on top of it.

Execution. The monetary effect, SGD 8.05, exceeds the execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this ruling issues but is not auto-executed; it is placed in the human queue for release under POL-GEN-05. Both parties retain the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

To both parties: this was a real detour, and the fare included distance and time for a route neither of you wanted. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00101) is complete — 229 fixes at the 10-second expected interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0.0 s — so it is NOT impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c), and under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs (27.18 km, not the rounded 27.2 km convenience copy on the trip_record). Against the booked optimal of 21.0 km (EV-TRIP-00101) the excess is 6.18 km, or 29.4%. That clears both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (over 0.8 km and over 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It does not reach either material threshold (8.0 km / 50%), so this is a partial-refund case and the POL-RD-06 uplift to a full refund is not available however the deviation is characterised.

No exculpatory clause applies. There is no traffic advisory on file — EV-ADVIS-00101-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 — so POL-RD-03 cannot be run on the record and, under POL-RD-13, no external-cause excuse carries weight; in any event the driver's own in-app message says he 'missed the exit, coming back now' (EV-CHAT-00101), which is his own mistake, not a closure, and his counterparty_statement repeats it. There is no rider instruction to detour (POL-RD-04), no pickup/dropoff amendment — both amendment timestamps are null (POL-RD-05), the fare model is METERED not upfront (POL-RD-11), and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not a pooled trip (POL-RD-12).

Under POL-RD-02 the refund is arithmetic, not discretionary. Reading the surge multiplier of 1.0 from the fare_breakdown (EV-FARE-00101), where the field lives: recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 × 21.0 km + 0.28 × 26.0 min) × 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 27.63, with no ERP, toll, surcharge, waiting fee or promo line to adjust. Charged_total = 35.64. Refund = 35.64 − 27.63 = 8.01, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 8.05. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and 22.5% of the total, well below the 90% share that would make it a full refund, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 8.05. There are no pass-through lines to correct (all ERP, toll and surcharge figures are 0.00), so POL-RD-09 adds nothing, and no billing-integrity referral arises. No driver compensation arises either: the fare charged 27.2 km against the trace's 27.18 km — the rider was billed more, not less.

On the driver's profile: no repeat-deviation pattern is established — deviation_flags_90d is 0, and 0 / 812 completed_trips_90d is 0, below both limbs — and the deviation is not material, so no POL-RD-06 driver-conduct referral issues.
